representation_fit.evidence: Brief's primary object change_set + temporal-sequence shape is the literal interface: a vertical change timeline of 8 change sets in ascending time with day separators (screenshots 1280x860/1440x900; app.js:25-27 sorts by ts, index.html:42 aria-label '按时间升序，自上而下'), directed causal links rendered as 因（更早）/果（更晚） badges and jump cards (app.js:151-162,246-254), plus a state replay of element values at the selected moment (app.js:107-125,287-324) — representation matches the understand/evolving-state job directly.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Timeline pane is the dominant surface (grid 11fr/9fr, styles.css:157) and the app boots pre-selected on the latest change set cs-08 with its causal cards, change detail, and state snapshot populated on first paint (app.js:69; both screenshots show cs-08 detail + 状态快照 filled without any interaction). Header quantifies the corpus: '8 个变更集 · 18 条变更 · 7 条因果链接 · 08-31 → 09-04' (app.js:366-371).

time_to_understand.evidence: Orientation cues are explicit on the initial screen: pane label '时间线 上早 ↓ 下晚' (index.html:44), day separators 08-31 周一…(screenshots), legend decoding +/~/−/→ and 因/果 with direction (index.html:20-28), and header meta with counts and date window. What/where is conveyed at a glance in both viewports.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object reachable in 0 steps (all 8 change sets listed on the single main screen); selection is one click via delegated handler (app.js:406-414), causal neighbors one click via data-jump badges/cards with scroll+flash (app.js:383-404), and ArrowUp/ArrowDown keyboard traversal is supported (app.js:443-452). No modes, routes, or drill-downs.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: selection and causal jumps update inspector/state panel while the full timeline stays mounted and scrolls to the node (app.js:383-404); type/element filters dim non-matching rows instead of removing them to preserve temporal structure ('当前筛选下无匹配变更（已置灰保留结构）', app.js:182-194,199-204; styles.css:225,284). No navigation away, no modal state.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces are exactly what the job needs and nothing more: topbar+legend, one filter bar (5 type chips, 1 element select, clear button, status note — index.html:31-39), timeline pane, inspector, state replay (index.html:41-53). Every control is functional (wired in app.js:421-441); no decorative nav, settings, or placeholder modules at either viewport.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Consistent with source: faint 11px meta/labels (--text-faint #5f6b7e, styles.css:13,167,250), compact chip padding 3px 12px (styles.css:107-116) and causal badges 2px 7px at 11px font (styles.css:254-268); timeline nodes are tabindex="-1" articles with keyboard access only via a custom arrow handler (app.js:184,443-452). Some mitigation exists: :focus-visible outline (styles.css:459-463), aria-pressed chips, role=status/alert, prefers-reduced-motion (styles.css:232).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects: layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json), and both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show clean two-pane layout with no clipped or colliding text. However 4 of 7 checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size), each implying corrective work on contrast ratios, focus ordering, and the 11-13px type/target scale (styles.css:34,107-116,254-268).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is enforced, not just asserted: startup validation requires strictly increasing changeSet timestamps (app.js:31-36) and every causalLink to satisfy cause.ts < effect.ts, reporting violations in an error banner (app.js:38-53,456-462); data.js:130-145 satisfies it (all 7 links point forward, e.g. cl-5 cs-04 09-01→cs-06 09-03). Timeline order = replay order by construction (single sorted `sets` array shared by render and replayTo, app.js:25-27,110-112), and badge direction semantics are hard-coded 因=earlier/果=later (app.js:153-160). Screenshots show no integrity banner and internally consistent counts (18 changes, 9 elements in 状态快照).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast=fail (measurement-summary.json) — dim/faint text tiers, e.g. --text-faint #5f6b7e at 11px (styles.css:13,167)
a11y.focus_order=fail (measurement-summary.json) — change-set nodes are tabindex="-1" articles reachable only via a custom ArrowUp/Down handler (app.js:184,443-452)
a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json) — chips padded 3px 12px (styles.css:107-116) and causal badges 2px 7px at 11px (styles.css:254-268)
scores.overall_note: This package is a close match to the brief's cell (understand × temporal-sequence, object change_set): the initial screen is a strictly time-ascending change-set timeline with day separators, an explicit 上早↓下晚 orientation label, directed 因（更早）/果（更晚） causal badges on nodes, jump-to-cause/effect cards with reasons in the inspector, and a state replay panel that recomputes element values as of the selected moment (app.js:25-27,107-125,151-162,246-324; screenshots at 1280x860 and 1440x900). The acceptance seed is enforced in code — timestamp ordering and cause-earlier-than-effect are validated at startup with a visible error banner path (app.js:31-53,456-462) — and the on-screen counts (18 changes, 7 links, 9 elements) are internally consistent with the data. Navigation and context costs are minimal (single screen, one-click selection, one-click causal jumps, arrow-key traversal, filters that dim rather than remove), and no layout defects are visible in either viewport, matching the pass on layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, and text.truncation. The clear weakness is accessibility: all three a11y receipt checks fail (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size) plus type.min_projected_size, consistent with an 11-13px type scale and compact chip/badge hit areas, despite genuine affordances like :focus-visible outlines, aria-pressed, role=status/alert, and prefers-reduced-motion. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; the accessibility score reflects receipt checks and source structure, not a human study.
